name: @golemdocs/server
description: GolemDocs API server: documents, collaboration and accounts (private workspace package, not on npm)

scripts.dev: tsx ../scripts/wrangler-config.ts && mkdir -p .no-assets && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --env dev --port 3001
scripts.dev:local: tsx ../scripts/wrangler-config.ts && mkdir -p .no-assets && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --env local --port 3001
scripts.cf:setup: wrangler d1 create golemdocs-directory && wrangler r2 bucket create golemdocs-files
scripts.cf:setup:dev: wrangler d1 create golemdocs-directory-dev && wrangler r2 bucket create golemdocs-files-dev
scripts.cf:migrate:dev: tsx ../scripts/wrangler-config.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply --config wrangler.generated.jsonc DIRECTORY --env dev --remote
scripts.cf:migrate:local: tsx ../scripts/wrangler-config.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply --config wrangler.generated.jsonc DIRECTORY --env local --local
scripts.cf:migrate: tsx ../scripts/wrangler-config.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply --config wrangler.generated.jsonc DIRECTORY --env="" --remote
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm --filter @golemdocs/client build && tsx ../scripts/wrangler-config.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --env=""
